title: Fed-MediShield bsc_3 Phase 2 replication: pre-registration

seed_roles.note: Seed 48 was run before this file was written, with the identical frozen source and calibration; it is included because nothing was changed after seeing it.

protocol: Default CLI settings of the frozen files: 8 clients, saved grouped partition, 15 rounds, 2 local epochs, batch 2048, AdamW lr 0.001, threads 2; attacker client 7, poison rate 0.2, target Benign, constant trigger value 5 on features 0-3, attack from round 1 every round. Matched undefended reference: train_defended.py --defense fedavg with the same seed.
primary_metrics: Mean triggered->Benign excess over the matched clean run, over attack rounds (pp)
Clean macro-F1 difference vs matched clean FedAvg (pp)
Worst per-class clean recall difference vs matched clean FedAvg (pp)
Update-level detection rate and first detected poisoned participation

per_seed_pass_criteria.clean_screen: built-in gate passes (FPR <= 5%, unpoisoned retention >= 90%, macro-F1 >= 65, every class recall >= 10)

aggregate_reporting: Every seed reported individually, including failures and detector stops; mean and sample SD over the five evaluation seeds. Rounds are not independent samples.
decision_rule: Replication supported only if all five seeds pass every criterion. Any failure is reported as such; no thresholds, settings or seeds are changed after seeing results. A changed method requires new evaluation seeds.
not_tested_by_this_phase: triggers outside the probe bank / benign-looking triggers
multiple attackers, other poison rates, other non-IID partitions
other datasets and the official test split
